context: Test 6 The Shapka Test. Given a query access to a function f : [n; d] → F2 : a. Choose a, b ∈ [n; d] uniformly at random. b. Choose x ∈ Ca,b uniformly at random. c. Query f at ρa,b (0), ρa,b (x), ρa,b (1) and ρa,b (x ⊕ 1). d. Accept iff f (ρa,b (0)) ⊕ f (ρa,b (x)) ⊕ f (ρa,b (1)) ⊕ f (ρa,b (x ⊕ 1)) = 0. We conjecture that this test is also good, i.e., if a function passes the test with high probability then it is close to a tensor product. APPROX/RANDOM 2019
